SELECT CHNL_SITE.CHNL_SITE_SEQ , CHNL_SITE.CHNL_SEQ , CHNL_SITE.SITE_SEQ , CHNL_SITE.CHNL_CD , CHNL_SITE.SITE_CD , CHNL_SITE.USE_YN , CHNL.CHNL_NM , CHNL.CHNL_IP , CHNL.CHNL_PORT , CHNL.CHNL_DMN , CHNL.CHNL_BSC_URI , SITE.SITE_TP , ( SELECT CD_NM FROM CMN_CD_INFO_TBL WHERE 1 = 1 AND GRP_CD = 'CMN_SITE_INFO_001' AND CD = SITE.SITE_TP
) AS SITE_TP_NM , SITE.SITE_NM , SITE.SITE_BSC_URI , TO_CHAR(CHNL_SITE.RGST_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.MS') AS RGST_DT , CHNL_SITE.RGST_SEQ , ( SELECT ADM_NM FROM SYS_ADM_INFO_TBL WHERE 1 = 1 AND ADM_SEQ = CHNL_SITE.RGST_SEQ ) AS RGST_NM , TO_CHAR(CHNL_SITE.UPDT_DT, 'YYYY-MM-DD HH24:MI:SS.MS') AS UPDT_DT , CHNL_SITE.UPDT_SEQ , ( SELECT ADM_NM FROM SYS_ADM_INFO_TBL WHERE 1 = 1 AND ADM_SEQ = CHNL_SITE.UPDT_SEQ ) AS UPDT_NM FROM CMN_CHNL_SITE_MAP CHNL_SITE LEFT OUTER JOIN CMN_CHNL_INFO_TBL CHNL ON CHNL_SITE.CHNL_SEQ = CHNL.CHNL_SEQ LEFT OUTER JOIN CMN_SITE_INFO_TBL SITE ON CHNL_SITE.SITE_SEQ = SITE.SITE_SEQ WHERE 1 = 1 AND (((#{useYn, jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL) OR (#{useYn, jdbcType=VARCHAR} = '')) OR (CHNL_SITE.USE_YN = #{useYn, jdbcType=VARCHAR})) AND (((#{chnlSeq, jdbcType=NUMERIC} IS NULL) OR (#{chnlSeq, jdbcType=NUMERIC} = 0)) OR (CHNL_SITE.CHNL_SEQ = #{chnlSeq, jdbcType=NUMERIC})) AND (((#{siteSeq, jdbcType=NUMERIC} IS NULL) OR (#{siteSeq, jdbcType=NUMERIC} = 0)) OR (CHNL_SITE.SITE_SEQ = #{siteSeq, jdbcType=NUMERIC})) AND (((#{chnlCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL) OR (#{chnlCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR} = '')) OR (CHNL_SITE.CHNL_CD = #{chnlCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR})) AND (((#{siteCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR} IS NULL) OR (#{siteCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR} = '')) OR (CHNL_SITE.SITE_CD = #{siteCd, jdbcType=VARCHAR})) ORDER BY CHNL_SITE.CHNL_SITE_SEQ ASC
